data.missingPolicy: Abort on missing, duplicate, invalid, unclosed or misaligned candles; no interpolation or synthetic fallback.
data.cachePolicy: Immutable validated 250-bar pages, bounded provider retries, 150ms between requests; gzip complete cache for public reproduction.

exposureDisclosure: June 10 through September 10 2026 was already exposed by the original research. Recent June 12-September 10 is robustness context only. Jan 1-June 9 2026 has not previously been used by this project, not a claim of universally blind data. Endpoints are exclusive. Current rules are counterfactually applied to all historical dates.

execution.signals: Only completed UTC 1h bars, aggregated from four validated 15m bars; SMA-seeded EMA20/80 and Wilder ATR14, continuous causal history with 336h minimum warmup. Orders eligible only at immediately following 15m open; no same-close fills.
execution.portfolio: One position total. BTC then ETH deterministic priority, never selected using future returns. Long and short unit-contract CFD proxy; quantity floored to 8 decimals, not verified broker lots.
execution.hours: Monday-Thursday entries 06:00 <= UTC < 16:00, Friday 06:00 <= UTC < 14:00. No weekend entries. Flat by 20:00 UTC each day and 16:00 Friday. Earlier Friday flat is an assumption, not verified server cutoff.
execution.gapFilter: Skip entry when absolute open minus signal close exceeds one signal ATR, or proposed stop is not beyond entry in loss direction.
execution.risk: Per-trade inclusive stop loss <= riskRate * min(initial capital, current equity). 90% of net available leveraged buying power, accounting for entry fee and opening liquidation spread/slippage/exit fee; single position. No pyramiding.
execution.exit: Fixed stop from signal close at stopAtr * ATR14. Target from actual entry at rewardRisk * distance to stop. Gap stops fill worse open, gap targets no improvement. Stop before target on ambiguous bar. Adverse exit spread/slippage and commission. Time exits on known bar close, terminal liquidation at final close.
execution.riskPath: Check balance and conservative liquidation equity at open before winners, entry, adverse reachable intrabar mark before stop/target, and close. Stop truncates continuous adverse path at stop, adverse opening gaps preserved. Entry-bar extrema order unknown; stop-first is pessimistic. One position avoids asynchronous cross-asset extrema.
execution.drawdown: Close DD uses close peaks. Intrabar DD is a conservative bound: a bar's favorable mark (capped at target when relevant) may precede its adverse mark (capped at stop); ordering unknown, so risk hits using such peaks are possible/indeterminate, not proven tick breaches.
execution.dayAttribution: UTC+3 date of entry counts as an evaluation trading day; not verified platform attribution. Completed-trade dates also recorded. Daily baseline max(opening balance, opening equity), locked for day; both balance/equity touch tested. Fixed UTC+3 throughout, historical DST not verified.
execution.swapAssumption: Zero swaps because modeled exits precede assumed rollover; actual rollover and crypto swap schedule unknown. No claim of swap-free crypto or verified avoidance.
execution.modes: Economic standalone uses same cost-aware sizing without account/daily/DD halts to expose continuing losses. Managed standalone and challenge include internal daily stop and persistent 6% close-peak-to-adverse-equity halt, plus firm floors. No research writes to original account.

costDisclosure: Published 0.04% crypto formula is interpreted PER SIDE conservatively; actual side convention, contract size, lot minimum/step, spreads, slippage, swaps and margin inventory unavailable. Spot candles are mid proxies, not CFD bid/ask. Stress is hypothetical, not actual FundingPips costs. Break-even all-in bps is exact on fixed simulated quantities/mid entry-exit paths, not a reoptimized trade set.

families.hypothesis: Low-turnover directional continuation after range break; time-series momentum literature motivates hypothesis, not intraday crypto CFD profitability.
families.rule: EMA20>EMA80 and close above prior N hourly highs -> long; inverse for short. Exclude signal bar from range. Stop 2 ATR; target 3R; max hold 8h.

families.hypothesis: Enter established trend after temporary retracement, reducing breakout chasing; conjecture only.
families.rule: EMA20>EMA80, prior close<=prior EMA20 and current close>EMA20 -> long; inverse for short. Stop N ATR; target 2R; max hold 8h.

families.hypothesis: Temporary liquidity-driven overshoot in non-trending regimes; costs/adverse selection may dominate. Not a demonstrated edge.
families.rule: abs(EMA20-EMA80)<=ATR14; prior close outside prior SMA20 +/- N population standard deviations and current close reenters its current band -> long from lower / short from upper. Stop 1.5 ATR; target 1.5R; max hold 4h.

families.hypothesis: Expansion after an overnight range during liquid hours; session effect is conjectural, not news betting.
families.rule: UTC 00:00-06:00 range width between 1 and 4 current ATR14; signal close time 07:00-12:00 inclusive crosses that range from inside -> long/short. Stop N ATR; target 2R; max hold 6h.

selection.developmentCases: All 16: economic baseline training, baseline validation, double-cost validation; plus managed baseline training/validation. Full trade/daily ledgers saved for every attempt, including failures.
selection.eligibility: Economic baseline training and validation each net positive, PF>=1.10; >=100 training and >=40 validation trades; both validation calendar quarters positive; double-cost validation positive; training and validation conservative intrabar DD<5%.
selection.score: min(annualized simple training return, annualized simple validation return, annualized simple double-cost validation return) / max(1, training intrabar DD%, validation intrabar DD%, double-cost validation intrabar DD%). Sort eligible first, descending score, then lexical candidate id.
selection.finalists: First two DISTINCT families in ranking, locked to selection.json before final execution. If fewer than two eligible families, fill remaining places with highest-ranked ineligible diagnostic controls. Never call these validated winners.
selection.finalCases: Each preselected finalist: economic base/double/triple, managed base, economic Master-1x sensitivity (not funded compliance), and its other preregistered parameter at same risk as nonselectable robustness neighbor. No final-winner selection. Recent exposed baseline economic context only.
selection.rejection: If no candidate clears development gates or final loses/net PF<1.10, report no credible usable strategy. Never optimize challenge pass rate or tune after final inspection.

cohorts.starts: Every 7 calendar days from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z while before final end; each uses only subsequent chronological data.
cohorts.rules: Managed strategy. Phase1 target +$400 realized net and flat, >=3 entry trading days. Phase2 starts at 00:00 UTC on subsequent UTC date, resets to $5000 without reuse of phase1 time. Phase2 target +$250 and >=3 days. No discretionary target flattening. Administrative waiting ignored/unknown.
cohorts.outcomes: pass, modeled breach, inactivity, internal risk stop, pending at analytical horizon, or right-censored at data end. Internal stop is not a firm breach. Target not reached is not automatically failure. Full observed horizons and all starts counted separately; halted phases never recover into a pass.
cohorts.uncertainty: Overlapping cohorts are dependent scenarios, not IID trials or future pass probabilities. Candle ambiguities remain conditional/indeterminate real compliance. Report phase target times, total time and outcome counts; no binomial confidence interval.

sources.title: Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen (2012), Time series momentum. Monthly futures evidence, NOT evidence for these hourly crypto rules.
